name: Market East Shopping Center
summary: Market East Shopping Center is a conveniently located retail destination at I-635 and Town East Boulevard in Mesquite, featuring chain and discount stores with quick-access shopping and dining options. Strategically positioned across from Town East Mall, the center serves the eastern Dallas area with everyday retail needs and services.
demographics: Market East Shopping Center serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in the Mesquite area of eastern Dallas County. The primary trade area attracts families and value-conscious shoppers with household incomes ranging from $40,000 to $75,000, including a significant Hispanic population reflective of Mesquite's demographics. The center draws both convenience-oriented shoppers seeking everyday necessities and bargain hunters looking for discount retail options, with typical visitors ranging from young families to middle-aged households seeking accessible, affordable shopping options in a convenient location near major transportation corridors.
description: Market East Shopping Center is strategically positioned at the northeast corner of Interstate 635 and Town East Boulevard in Mesquite, Texas, directly across from the prominent Town East Mall. This well-established retail destination serves the eastern Dallas metropolitan area with a diverse mix of chain stores, discount retailers, and convenient service providers. The center's prime location offers exceptional visibility and accessibility, benefiting from high traffic counts along I-635 and its proximity to one of the region's major enclosed malls. Designed as an open-air shopping venue, Market East provides shoppers with easy in-and-out access to a variety of everyday retail and dining options. The property is professionally managed by FRP Ltd., a real estate investment trust specializing in retail and mixed-use properties, ensuring consistent maintenance and tenant services that keep the center competitive in the Mesquite retail market.
